name: Introduction to Psychology and Human Behavior
description:
The course is an introduction to psychology. The focus is on human behavior and the key questions: Why do people act the way they do? What role does their environment play? How can human behavior be studied? 
Students gain insights into various areas of psychology (e.g. learning psychology, work and organizational psychology, social psychology). Based on current studies and research results, the course provides an overview of selected psychological models and theory as well as different methods of psychology.
